content: RaceCapture app: real-time dashboard with drag-drop custom pages/templates, pit-to-car alerts for overheating/coolant/oil starvation, built-in track database with lap timing, live-stream to Podium for lap comparison and remote coaching; ~30 channels at 5-10Hz, ~150MB/weekend over cellular; telemetry status LED (blue/green) and app connection status (dim green/green/yellow/red) as link-health indicator.
